div.div: رِفْلٌ , (IDrd, O, K, TA,) or, as in some copies of the Jm, ↓ رِفَلٌّ , (O, TA,) or ↓ رَفَلٌ , (accord. to a copy of the M,) or ↓ رَفِلٌ , (accord. to the CK,) [in the K said to be with kesr, which, accord. to a rule observed in that work, indicates that it is رِفْلٌ,] The skirt, or lower extremity, of a garment. (M, O, K.) You say, أَرْفَلَ رِفْلَهُ [explained above: see 2]. (K.) And قَمِيصٌ سَابِغُ الرِّفْلِ, i. e. [A shirt ample, or long,] in the skirt. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
